name: flight-card
title: Flight card
description: A flight option: departure and arrival in each airport's own time, duration and stops in words, airline, price and a select action, with every segment on demand.
docs: segments are the flights of the trip in order: { from, to, departure, arrival, carrier, flightNumber }, where from and to are airports { code, city?, timeZone } and the moments are ISO date-times with an offset or in UTC. Every time is written in its airport's own zone, with the abbreviation and the date in a tooltip (hover, tap or keyboard focus on the two main times). The route line says 'Direct', '1 stop in Zurich, 1h 20m' or '2 stops in Zurich and Madrid', shows a dot for every stop and the total duration (on a narrow card the duration joins the words under the line), and a landing on a later local day says '+1 day'. price is in minor units with priceNote ('per person'), cabin and baggage are plain strings and badge is a word in the corner ('Cheapest'). selected draws a heavier border and a button that says 'Selected'; onSelect is called by the button. The card's hidden heading names it by route, departure and airline ('Amsterdam to Lisbon, departs 07:25, Northwind Air': labels.title with {from}, {to}, {time} and {carrier}) and describes the button, so two flights on one route are told apart. 'Flight details' lists every segment with the layovers between them. Price and button sit beside the route from 36rem and below it on a narrow card. locale writes the times and the price, and labels holds every fixed word.
